audit.venue: Communications on Pure and Applied Mathematics
audit.summary: The central hyperbolic and flat-torus masses, iteration factors, puncturing logic, selected annular consequences and determinant renormalization were checked. Exact symbolic calculations support the constants, and two-precision numerical diagnostics reproduce C2 and C. This bounded initial review does not certify every external theorem or the journal version.

Limitations: No comparison of earlier preprint or publisher final; no author code or source numerical figure data used.
